meaning: The Milky Way's bulge and bar in old stars, drawn whole from anywhere in the Local Group, beside the arm tracers and nested levels of its dots.
basis: Presentation choices, 2026-09-30: every old star is drawn within 100 kpc of the Sun, so the bulge keeps its shape from outside the galaxy; at most 3,500 show at once (screenBudget), an even, stable share past that. From within the galaxy they would cover the view, so the bank fades out as the view's half-width at the Sun narrows from 9 kpc to 3 kpc (fadeOutUnits), as the 3 kpc neighbourhood level fills in, and draws nothing below it.
